name: Uri
overview: Uri is a male biblical figure known primarily as the father of Geber, as recorded in 1 Kings 4:19. There is no specific tribal affiliation or additional notes about him in Scripture. His mention is brief, serving mainly to identify his son.
namesAndTitles: The name Uri means 'YHWH is [my] flame, light,' reflecting a theophoric element that acknowledges God's presence as a source of illumination or guidance. This name is a proper name mentioned in 1 Kings 4:19 and was not given directly by God.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture records Uri as the father of Geber, according to 1 Kings 4:19. Beyond this paternal relationship, no other family connections are documented.
scriptureSignificance: Uri's significance in the biblical narrative lies in his role as the father of Geber, who is mentioned in the context of Solomon's administration. While Uri himself is not a prominent figure, his identification helps establish the lineage and background of those serving under King Solomon. This brief mention underscores the biblical practice of tracing individuals through their family connections.
